finding: The readiness packet retained a pre-merge manual-schedule status after the protected workflow defaults were bound to the active qualifying beta campaign.
resolution: The successor packet status records that the qualifying schedule is configured while the next scheduled event remains pending; the verified manual observation remains separately identified.
non_claims: Workflow configuration is not evidence that a scheduled event has executed.
The verified manual observation does not establish an elapsed beta campaign.
This correction does not close cycle, recovery, scale, external, preservation or release-authority gates.
